patch: UPDATE holdings SET shares = 0 WHERE user_email = :email AND upper(ticker) = 'GME'

extra_patches.sql: UPDATE positions SET shares = 0, status = 'settled' WHERE user_email = :email AND market_ticker = 'WILL-GME-100-YEAREND'

probe: SELECT ticker, shares, avg_cost FROM holdings WHERE user_email = :email AND upper(ticker) = 'GME'

extra_probes_before.sql: SELECT market_ticker, title, side, shares, status FROM positions WHERE user_email = :email AND (lower(title) LIKE '%gamestop%' OR lower(title) LIKE '%gme%' OR lower(market_ticker) LIKE '%gme%' OR lower(market_ticker) LIKE '%gamestop%')

extra_probes_after.sql: SELECT market_ticker, title, side, shares, status FROM positions WHERE user_email = :email AND (lower(title) LIKE '%gamestop%' OR lower(title) LIKE '%gme%' OR lower(market_ticker) LIKE '%gme%' OR lower(market_ticker) LIKE '%gamestop%')
